curation.notes: AFM imaging (PeakForce Tapping) plus AFM force spectroscopy and dynamic-mechanical-analysis microrheology on native human mitotic chromosomes isolated from U2OS TRF1-BirA H2B-eGFP cells, adsorbed on poly-L-lysine glass in polyamine buffer. Two instruments are used: a Bruker Bioscope Catalyst for imaging/indentation (DNPS10 probes) and a Bruker NanoWizard V for microrheology with a 870 nm-radius cylindrical probe oscillated at 2, 20 and 200 Hz. Indentation of a chromatin assembly, not stretching of a single molecule.

hardware.model_number: Bioscope Catalyst (imaging and force spectroscopy); NanoWizard V BioAFM (microrheology)

afm.cantilever_model: Bruker DNPS10 cantilever C (force spectroscopy); Olympus BLAC40TS (imaging); modified PFQNM-LC-A-CAL / SAA-SPH-1UM (microrheology)

spring_constant.note: nominal, DNPS10 cantilever C used for all AFM-FS; imaging probe 0.1 N/m; microrheology probe 0.137 N/m

evidence.snippet: DNPS10 probes (cantilever C, nominal tip radius 10 nm, nominal elastic constant 0.24 N/m, from Bruker, Camarillo, CA, USA), calibrated with the thermal noise method44 were used for all the AFM-FS measurements.

entities.name: Native human mitotic chromosome (U2OS TRF1-BirA H2B-eGFP)

evidence.snippet: Briefly, U2OS TRF1-BirA H2B-eGFP cells were cultured in high glucose GlutaMAX DMEM (Gibco), containing 10% FBS (Gibco) and penicillin-streptomycin (Gibco) at 37 °C, 5% CO2.
